{{Quote|Ah, the Jawas will salvage it eventually anyway. Then we can buy it back and start over. Heh. Makes sense to me.|The Czerka mining team captain to Revan|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A [[Unidentified Czerka mining team|Czerka Corporation mining team]] was operated on a [[Unidentified Czerka sandcrawler|sandcrawler]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and was lead by a '''captain'''. [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] attacked the [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]], immobilizing it and sending multiple waves of Tuskens to finish them off. However [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] intervened and defended the mining team. They left the sandcrawler in the desert for the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] to scavenge so they could buy it back from them.
